description: Creates an absorption shield on the target. Shield HP is added to the unit's shieldHp pool and absorbs incoming damage. Shield amount is based on attribute values, with optional decay and sub-buff application. Interacts with STATE_TRIGER(Shield) and shield_hp_extra.

ShieldSourceType.note: Bitfield in _hpType for determining attribute source (caster vs target)

param1.description: Bitfield: 1=Attack(read from caster), 2=Target(read from target). Used in calType 0 to pick source.

param2.description: Shield calculation type (0-3). Determines base shield value.

param4.description: If 0, apply shieldDecay multiplier. Otherwise no decay applied.

param5.description: param5[0] = array of [buffId, skillParScale] pairs to apply on shield creation. param5[1] = array of [buffId, duration, skillParScale] to apply on shield destruction.

onShieldAction.description: Called when shield absorbs damage. Returns amount absorbed.
onShieldAction.formula: absorbed = min(shieldValue, incomingDamage); shieldHp -= absorbed; if shieldValue <= 0: stop buff
onShieldAction.notes: Shield HP is tracked both on buff instance (_value) and unit data (owner.data.shieldHp)

onDestroy.description: When shield expires or is fully depleted
steps: Stop all sub-buffs created during onBegin
Apply param5[1] destruction buffs if defined

interactions.STATE_TRIGER_Shield: Triggers STATE_TRIGER with Shield state on creation
interactions.shield_hp_extra: Bonus shield HP multiplier from target attributes
interactions.shield_time_extra: Duration extension applied in addBuff (SkillRunner), not in BuffShield itself
interactions.shieldDecay: Global battle decay factor for shields (applied when _isDec == 0)
